about_the_game:
In this Demo of Fantastic Findings: Help Santa to find his missing reindeer and prepare for Christmas! In this Demo, you will be able to explore and collect an abundance of Christmas items in the first two packed levels of the game. Find decorations and delicious foods, which are hidden in the most detailed and intricate environments in full 3D. 


Find the keys, to locked drawers and doors and open containers to discover the hidden objects in each detailed and colorful level, each featuring an extensive playlist of cozy Christmas music. 


Each level offer lots of varieties and varied items to be found, from international Christmas treats to ugly sweaters and specific holiday decorations.

Collect lots of additional eatable items, dust off the spiderwebs and sweep away the dirt; if you wish to obtain a perfect score.

The spirit of Christmas awaits! Happy Holidays!


Features awaiting in the full game:

  • Simple Point & Click controls in detailed 3D environments. No keyboard required!

  • Collect 100+ Varied and unique quest items and collectibles.

  • Explore and enjoy the wonderful Christmas themed atmosphere.

  • A curious riddle based hint system based on gingerbread currency.

  • Explore and learn different Christmas culture references when inspecting each item.

  • Extensive and cozy (Non-vocal) Christmas music playlists.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti, 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 7750, 2GB
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 Ti, 2GB or AMD Radeon R7 260X, 2GB or Intel Arc A310, 4GB
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Get into the coziest Christmas spirit in this highly detailed 3D hidden object game. Explore many varied levels packed with hidden items waiting to be found. Search drawers, unwrap gifts. You can clean off dirt, cobwebs, eat treats, and find hidden cookies in a festive hunt full of surprises.
